question: Do high long gdp per capita countries have higher negative affects? Explain the results.
query: SELECT AVG(negative_affect) AS avg_neg_affect, log_GDP_per_capital FROM world_happiness_report WHERE log_GDP_per_capita > (SELECT p.log_GDP_per_capita * 1.5 FROM world_happiness_report p ORDER BY p.log_GDP_per_capita DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY log_GDP_per_capita ORDER BY avg_neg_affect DESC LIMIT 50
